statements.markdown: A theorem (zero_free_all_of_green_v_win) derives that statement from three hypotheses, and with the passage to all characters it reads every_character_of_green_v_win : Green −→ VWin −→ Nonempty(HypsAlt) −→ EveryCharacter,

lean.name: UpperTheory.Top.every_character_of_green_v_win
lean.note: The wrapper keeps the three hypotheses and extends the primitive-character result to every character.
lean.fidelity_note: `TopPlug.lean` has the displayed conclusion `EveryCharacter` and the same three inputs. The abbreviated third input is inhabitation of `HypsAlt` instantiated with the closedness condition for `LinkN` and with `DefiniteSideCondition`.

lean.name: UpperTheory.Top.zero_free_all_of_green_v_win
lean.note: This is the theorem named in the prose just before the display. Its conclusion `ZeroFreeAll` ranges over primitive characters and excludes zeros to the right of $1/2$. The displayed theorem takes the same inputs and applies `Top.imprimitive` to extend the conclusion. The primitive-character theorem applies the window exponent three halves and obtains hosts from supplyChi.
